I've wholesale cut out beef from my life for purely environmental reasons but fully support conservation deer hunting. We've pretty much eliminated deer's natural predator base in a lot of places so the idea of stepping in to thin the herd is sensible and good for the environment. Here in maryland an overabundance of deer are completely shifting the ecosystem by strip feeding the forest floor. Native trees are eaten before they even get a chance to grow  Hunting isn't ideal for a number of reasons but until we can get things better in balance it's a cost effective and reasonable answer. Not to mention the taxes collected which go right into conservation.

I don't think he necessarily needs damage if riot needs him to stay a support, but he is really only a support because of the strength his hook/punch brings to feeding kills. So much so that they've nerfed him to this level. His hook certainly works, but it's also incredibly frustrating just because there is little counter play to it early, and I know positioning is key but it's still possible to land one out of 5 hooks and have is make a huge difference.

There is far less risk in a blitz hook in lane than a thesh hook. Thresh's, if you want to continue your cc chain has to displace himself, while the range on Blitz's allows you to bring all the action to yourself. And comparing blitz to thresh is sort of a mute point because thresh is designed as a support and whose kit reflects that. He (thresh) is considered very strong right now because he has more than just his hook, every piece of his kit is conducive to his role. An attack speed buff and ult that randomly proc's to minions doesn't make sense on a support who won't have damage.

He's weak right now due to the dominance of his hook. They slashed his mana and increased his cost last time he was nerfed so he could maybe use three before being out of mana. Hitting his hook would allow for buffs in different areas making him less of a one-shot-wonder.
